recommendation: UNRESOLVED, and the highest measured leverage of any single edit: E_DAG1_CLEAVED = E_PC6 and E_DAG1_CLEAVABLE gives 35 -> 38 and breaks TWO classes (E_DAG1_CLEAVED out of the nine-member secretory class, and E_DAG1_FULL out of the barrier trio via E_DAG1_FULL = not E_DAG1_CLEAVED). Do NOT build E_DAG1_CLEAVABLE from the mutant alone -- that would be an evaluation-only construct, not biology. Full text (MISSREF-002) is wanted for the quantitative enzyme-to-product relationship.

lost_distinction_if_not_made: PKA-selective and EPAC-selective cAMP analogues are one intervention
recommendation: REJECT THE NODE, KEEP THE VERDICT. Full text (Kusama 2013, PDF now held) settles the encoding question negatively: EPAC1/EPAC2/RAP1 knockdown 'SIGNIFICANTLY INHIBITED' rather than abolished the PKA-driven response, and the EPAC analogue alone was inert. The arm is a GRADED POTENTIATOR, and a rate-free Boolean model cannot express potentiation at all. So no EPAC node should be added -- not because the biology is weak but because the model class cannot represent it. The IN_cAMP/S_PKA coupling verdict still changes to ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED, because a PKA-selective and an EPAC-selective analogue remain two distinct interventions the model makes one. Revisit only if a relative-rate layer is ever declared.

VERIFIED 2026-09-16: Kurihara 2007 is held locally (PDF-033, full_text_inspected=yes) and confirms the chain and the BMP2 add-back rescue -- in MOUSE. Evidence is mouse uterine conditional knockout (REF-025 Franco 2010, REF-026 Kurihara 2007) and LIT-IHH-001 itself flags that human attachment causality is partly transferred from mouse genetics. Blocked on human or ADOC Hedgehog-pathway-activity data.
